brief: An IDR-first net-worth and investing tracker for Indonesian users. It should feel calm, honest and precise: a tool for counting, not a trading casino.
criteria: Distinct from blue fintech marks and upward arrows, readable at 16 px, works in one colour, ties to 'every rupiah counts'.

concepts.name: Growing dots
concepts.idea: The second i-dot is bigger than the first: small amounts become value.
rationale: The promise lives inside the name itself
One accent detail: the big dot is the only red
The two i's become the app icon and favicon

recommendation: Growing dots: the wordmark is the logo, the two i's are the icon.
next_steps: Trademark search for the name and mark
Use the web icon set in the app
Apply the clear-space and minimum-size rules
